title: Haye nana Shaam Ne Maar Diya hai
body:
rauze pe nabi ke aake, shano ke neel dihkake
zainab ye buka karti thi
<<MINI>>
haye nana shaam ne maar diya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dukh sham e ghariban ke sehkar zinda rahi ghazi ki khwahar
jab barse aseero par pathar sar ghazi ka naize se gira
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ka jigar chalni dekha saabir ki behan ne sabr kiya
durro se badan zakhmi tha mera mai chup thi magar mehboob e khuda
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aun o mohamed qatl hue shabbir utha laaye laashe
mai shukr ke karti thi sajde sar ooncha mera bachon ne kiya
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
daman may utha kar jab shaahe huda jab qasim ka laaye laasha
chup chup ke kiya maine girya gham apna kabhi zaahir na kiya
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun mar na gayi ab sochti hoo abid ka baha jab aankh se khoon
zinda rahi mai bechain o sukoon sham aagaya jis dam maine suna
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
tar khoon may hua asghar ka gala tha teer bhi uske khad se bada
bano ko dilaasa maine diya karti rahi mai be-taygh [wigha]
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
us shehre sitam may ay nana kya tumse kahoo kya haal hua
fizza ko kisi ne kuch na kaha durro ki mili zainab ko saza
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ne sakina ko poocha mai kya kehti rone ke siwa
jab usne bahot majboor kiya tab sar ko jhukaye maine kaha
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sher e khuda ki beti thi abbas ke tewar rakhti thi
jo maut se bhi ek pal na dari us bibi ko rehaan o raza
<<MINI>>
shaam ne maar diya hai
haye nana....
